description: Open a file (File > Open, Open As): PSD, PSB, TIFF, JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, PDF, EPS, DCS, camera raw and DNG, HEIF, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, JPEG 2000, OpenEXR, Radiance, Cineon, DICOM, IFF, PCX, PICT, Pixar, PBM, Scitex CT, Targa, WBMP, Photoshop 2.0, Photoshop Raw, video and audio (as video layers), or a .psdt template (which opens as a new untitled document). openAs reads the file as PDF, EPS, Photoshop Raw or DICOM with that format's options, also when the extension does not match the contents

asSmartObject.description: Open as a smart object. Default false

openAs.description: Read the file as this format, with options. pdf: a generic (not Photoshop) PDF page or image, rasterized (Import PDF). eps: rasterize generic EPS. raw: headerless Photoshop Raw data. dicom: medical images

options.description: pdf: select (page|image): open a page or an embedded image. Default page; page (integer 1-100000): page (or image) number, from 1; name (text): name of the new document; cropTo (bounding_box|media_box|crop_box|bleed_box|trim_box|art_box); width (pixels 1-); height (pixels 1-); constrainProportions (true/false); resolution (number 1-10000): pixels per inch; mode (rgb|cmyk|grayscale|lab); bitsPerChannel (8|16); antiAlias (true/false); suppressWarnings (true/false). eps: width (pixels 1-); height (pixels 1-); constrainProportions (true/false); resolution (number 1-10000); mode (rgb|cmyk|grayscale|lab); antiAlias (true/false). raw: width (integer 1-300000); height (integer 1-300000); channels (integer 1-56); bitsPerChannel (8|16); byteOrder (ibm|mac); headerSize (integer 0-1000000000): bytes to skip; interleaved (true/false); retainHeader (true/false). dicom: anonymize (true/false): remove patient data; showOverlays (true/false); windowLevel (number -100000-100000); windowWidth (number 0-100000); rows (integer 1-100): frames per column when opening frames as a grid; columns (integer 1-100); reverse (true/false): reverse frame order

name: open_document
title: Open Document
